# x402 JSON Canonicalizer

> Produce deterministic, key-sorted JSON for hashing, cache keys and agent diffs. x402 micropayments (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/canonicalize – service info
- POST /api/canonicalize – paid canonicalization

## Pricing

~0.004 – 0.012 USDC per call (default max 0.008 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "data": { "b": 2, "a": 1, "nested": { "z": true, "y": null } },
  "options": {
    "sortArrays": false,
    "removeNulls": true,
    "space": 0
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "canonical": "{\"a\":1,\"b\":2,\"nested\":{\"z\":true}}",
  "parsed": { ... },
  "hashHint": "a1b2c3d4"
}
```

Agents use this before writing to vector stores, comparing configs, or generating stable cache keys.
